svg.title: Two valid term counts and a strict sum threshold
svg.desc: For first term twelve and difference minus two, the fourth and ninth prefix sums both equal thirty-six. The fifteenth prefix sum equals minus thirty, so it fails the strict less-than condition. The sixteenth sum is minus forty-eight, the first value below minus thirty. The graph consists only of integer-index points.
